# Gatewright

> Gatewright is an open-source PMO harness for programmes that run on gates - capital projects, integrations, transformations, product programmes. It connects your schedule tool, planner, mailbox and document store, scores each gate against a configurable gate model, runs chasers and forecasts, and exposes everything as MCP tools.

In design, about 40%: specification rev B, no code yet. Built in public by Aleks Sidorecs as part of Automatiqa Lab, MIT. Not related to OPA Gatekeeper (Kubernetes) or macOS Gatekeeper. Not a scheduling tool, not a document store, not an autonomous PMO: agents observe, propose, draft or act within policy, and three hard limits are fixed in code.
